positive.sql: SELECT menu.pizza_name, menu.price, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM menu JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_order WHERE person_order.menu_id = menu.id) ORDER BY pizza_name, price;
